$comment: Where every asset the game ships, or its store pages show, comes from. One entry per asset or asset family: its path (a file, directory or glob, in the tree or in the build output), its source (authored by hand in the tree, generated by a script from something in the tree, or third-party), its licence, and for a generated asset the command that makes it and, when a model made it, where the prompt is. Nothing here is third-party: the game vendors no font, sample, image or model. Keep it true in the same commit as a new asset family, a new generator, or art from outside the tree.

assets.note: The bleeding red moon, a hand-written vector; the one source of every icon.
The share card; its lettering is set in the build machine's system font.
Real frames of the running game, for the install prompt; committed.
The phone app's icons, rasterised by hand from pwa/public/icon.svg; no command regenerates them yet.
Build output: the desktop icons, re-encoded from pwa/public/maskable-icon-512x512.png.

Hand-authored pixel grids with their palettes, except the recipe-built ones below. A grid may have been traced from an image model's draft (scripts/sprite-author.mjs rebuilds that prompt from the house style and the sprite's own subject); which ones is not recorded.
Deterministic recipe; the grids change only when it does.
Deterministic recipe for the garage's rocket.
Build output: the sprite atlas packed from content/sprites, and the pixel fonts from the glyphs defined in scripts/asset-tools/{font,font-hud,relic-font}.mjs.
Every sound effect is a list of synthesis parameters played by the game's own synthesiser; the game ships no audio file.
The soundtrack: ten original tracker scores (the .song short form compiles to the YAML with scripts/song-import.mjs), played by the game's chiptune sequencer.

assets.generator: an image model (which one was not recorded), then scripts/composite-steam-wordmarks.mjs for the lettering
assets.note: Steam key art. The prompts file holds the starting prompts only; the approved art was iterated beyond them, and each capsule's <name>.md records its scene and what it claims.

assets.generator: an image model (which one was not recorded)
assets.note: Steam key art with no lettering; the same caveat on the prompts.
The wordmark, drawn from the game's own pixel font.
Build output: the store screenshots, real captures of the staged game.
Build output: the Game Center and Steam badges, cut from the sprite atlas.
Build output, the /library/ site's images and web font: sprite previews, cards rendered from the game's own markup, and the pixel font packed as a web font.
The example mod's sprites, sounds and music, as YAML; dedicated to the public domain (mod/LICENSE.md).
